name: 491. A boolean vendor query parameter on GET /v1/models reaches the vendor as sent, or is refused (typed vendor query) [SERIAL]
description: TXE-7102 regression. Local fixture regression, no live provider calls: run with providerErrorFixture=1 against the gateway of tests/e2e/api/provider_config/provider-error-fixture.config.json, with tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs as the only upstream (the pp_cohere provider's base_url is the fixture). GET /v1/models forwards the query parameters the gateway does not read to the provider. A query string carries text, and the Cohere provider read default_only with a bool type assertion, so default_only=true never reached Cohere and every model was listed. The fixture keeps each Cohere model list read in /__wire with the query string as it arrived. The rows read back that default_only arrives as true and as false, and that a value that is not a boolean is refused with 400 caller_unsupported_parameter before any vendor call. Run the whole folder in order.

item.name: pp_cohere GET /v1/models with default_only=true: the vendor receives default_only=true (typed vendor query)

exec: pm.test('typed vendor query setup: the fixture was reset', function () {
pm.test('the client gets 200', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, text).to.equal(200); });
// wire: the request that reached the fixture, with the query string as it arrived.
pm.sendRequest({ url: FX + '/__wire', method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) {
pm.test('the fixture answered /__wire', function () { pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null); pm.expect(res.code).to.equal(200); });
pm.test('exactly one upstream call', function () { pm.expect(calls, res.text()).to.have.length(1); });
pm.test('the vendor received default_only as sent', function () { pm.expect((calls[0] || {}).query, res.text()).to.equal('?default_only=true&page_size=1000'); });

item.name: pp_cohere GET /v1/models with default_only=maybe: 400 caller_unsupported_parameter naming default_only, no vendor call (typed vendor query) [EXPECT-400]

exec: pm.test('typed vendor query setup: the fixture was reset', function () {
pm.test('the client gets 400', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, text).to.equal(400); });
pm.test('the body is JSON', function () { body = pm.response.json(); });
pm.test('error.param names default_only', function () { pm.expect((body.error || {}).param, text).to.equal('default_only'); });
// wire: nothing reached the fixture, the request was refused before any vendor call.
pm.sendRequest({ url: FX + '/__wire', method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) {
pm.test('the fixture answered /__wire', function () { pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null); pm.expect(res.code).to.equal(200); });
pm.test('no upstream call', function () { pm.expect(res.json().data[0].calls, res.text()).to.have.length(0); });
